x-xbert.tagline: Structured new-client onboarding with checklist, scope gate, and rules baseline.
prerequisites: Practice with templates configured for new-client tasks (workflow templates, rule baselines)
Engagement letter signed off (gate-checked before configuration begins)
v1 scope note: this plugin orchestrates the onboarding checklist and creates the workflow tasks — COA creation and opening-balance load are checklist items the bookkeeper does manually in the ledger
x-xbert.longDescription:
New-client onboarding is the single biggest source of cleanup work downstream. Skip the engagement letter sign-off and you discover scope creep three months in. Skip the chart-of-accounts confirmation and the client's reports never reconcile to their old ones. Skip the rules baseline and every transaction needs manual coding. Each shortcut feels small at the moment; each one compounds into months of fix-up.

XBert Client Onboard runs the four-phase onboarding lifecycle as a structured workflow — engagement, connection, configuration, go-live — with gate checks at each phase boundary that prevent skipping ahead. v1 orchestrates the checklist, creates the workflow tasks from your practice templates, and enforces the practice-owner gate. The COA-create and opening-balance-load steps remain checklist items the bookkeeper does manually in the ledger; v2 will automate those. The rules baseline (XBert rule pack the new client starts with) is assigned automatically once the bookkeeper confirms the client scope.

useCases.title: First-time client setup
useCases.description: Drive the new client through the four-phase onboarding with gate checks — no shortcut-taking, no missed steps.

useCases.title: Mid-onboarding sanity check
useCases.description: Run mid-onboarding to confirm where the client is in the four phases and which items are still outstanding.

useCases.title: Practice-wide onboarding consistency
useCases.description: Every onboarding goes through the same gates and creates the same workflow tasks from the same templates — no per-bookkeeper improvisation.

useCases.title: Rules baseline assignment
useCases.description: Once scope is confirmed, the new client's XBert rules baseline (which checks fire, which thresholds, which approvers) is assigned in one step.

benefits.title: Four-phase gated workflow
benefits.description: Engagement → connection → configuration → go-live. Each phase has explicit gate checks — no skipping ahead, no half-onboarded clients.

benefits.title: Practice-owner gate enforced
benefits.description: Engagement letter and scope confirmation are gate-checked before any configuration starts. The plugin won't proceed without sign-off.

benefits.title: Rules baseline in one step
benefits.description: Once scope is confirmed, the practice's standard XBert rule baseline is assigned to the new client — no manual rule-by-rule setup.

workflow: Confirm the new client name, the Connect tenant, and the engagement scope
Plugin checks current phase via the XBert MCP and presents the gated checklist
Walk through each phase's gate checks; the plugin creates workflow tasks from your practice templates as you progress
Final go-live step assigns the rules baseline. COA create + opening-balance load remain manual checklist items in the ledger (v1)
